environment_note: Every repository was extracted with `git archive` at its fetched origin/main revision into a fresh tree and tested THERE, in its own seeded uv venv. The working clones were read-only. Editable install with the repo's own dev extras, plus its PEP 735 dependency-groups and every requirements file its own gate declares. No tool was globally installed to make a check pass. GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN were unset for the health step: this sandbox exports a 14-character sentinel, and a non-empty token flips zizmor from offline to online mode, where github.com rejects the sentinel at git-upload-pack with 401 and the gate aborts before its audit runs.
integration_claim: none - repo-local health only, no cross-repo seam is implied by this layer

resolved_failures.diagnosis: `make ci` -> `make check` -> `make hooks` runs the repo's own zizmor pre-commit hook, which reports secrets-inherit (medium, audit confidence High) at .github/workflows/l9-nightly.yml:20 — `secrets: inherit` grants the called Core reusable workflow ALL of this repository's secrets. Pre-existing on main (file last changed by #89), NOT in the repo's .github/zizmor.yml suppression list, so the repo's own gate fails on it legitimately. 13 findings (1 ignored, 11 suppressed): 1 medium. Filed as Quantum-L9/l9-ci-sdk#96 with the full callee-chain analysis; not patched here because the fix turns on Core's secret contract, not on anything local.
